# FixFlow

> Self-hosted, Sentry-compatible error tracking in one Node 24+ process with SQLite. Groups events from Sentry SDKs, opens one GitHub issue per new group that has a stack trace, and has an LLM attempt a fix in a git worktree that it opens as a pull request. The model runs through Ollama (default qwen2.5-coder:7b), DeepSeek or Anthropic. Source-available under FSL-1.1-ALv2, not OSI open source.

Facts that are easy to get wrong:

- Grouping key: exception type + crashing file + that frame's source line text (not line number); the SDK `fingerprint` overrides it.
- Triage tags (bot-safe, needs-human, infrastructure, third-party, no-stack-trace, test-event) do not gate the resolver; it attempts every open issue FixFlow filed.
- The resolver's agent has read_file, list_directory, grep and edit_file, no shell; up to 20 turns per attempt; at most 3 failed attempts per issue.
- Install: the desktop app from the latest release (macOS Apple Silicon .dmg, Windows .exe, Linux AppImage); it bundles its own Node and needs only git. Running from source (Node 24+) is for Intel Macs, servers and development.
- No tracing, session replay, alert rules or multi-user accounts. Windows and Linux desktop builds untested. Fix success rate not measured.

## Docs

- [Quick start](https://ayesh96.github.io/FixFlow/#quick-start): download and first launch.
- [Download](https://github.com/Ayesh96/FixFlow/releases/latest)
- [Self-hosted error tracking](https://ayesh96.github.io/FixFlow/self-hosted-error-tracking/): listeners, data folder, what leaves the machine.
- [Sentry alternative](https://ayesh96.github.io/FixFlow/sentry-alternative/): scope and comparison with Sentry, GlitchTip, Bugsink.
- [Sentry errors to GitHub issues](https://ayesh96.github.io/FixFlow/sentry-errors-to-github-issues/): grouping, filing rules, issue contents, token permissions.
- [AI fixes as pull requests](https://ayesh96.github.io/FixFlow/ai-bug-fix-pull-requests/): attempt selection, agent loop, pull request contents, cost.
- [Error triage with Ollama](https://ayesh96.github.io/FixFlow/local-llm-error-triage/): providers, tags, guardrails, measured results.
- [Reference](https://ayesh96.github.io/FixFlow/reference/): every setting and the security model.
